title: Source
description: One document that supports one or more project facts. quote holds the exact extracts used.

primary.description: true for government or company documents; false for news.

snapshot_path.description: Path under data/snapshots/. Null for manual seeds until the collector re-fetches them.

quote_verified.description: true only once a human or the Checker has matched each quote against the live page or snapshot.

terms_status.description: n/a for third-party news/company pages read by hand, not collected.
